cohort: 3,623 live born infants admitted to 34 NICUs in Northeast Brazil
finding: Several factors including cesarean delivery, non-use of prenatal steroids, preeclampsia, oligohydramnios, birth weight < 2500g, 5-minute Apgar score < 7, endotracheal intubation, and non-use of surfactant were associated with death during NICU care up to the 27th day of life.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a decreased risk of neonatal death (OR=0.72; 95%CI: 0.56-0.95).
